title: Separate review and test-generation steps with role-specific tools and a forced output contract
expected_outcome: The review step gets read-only tools and the finding schema; the test step gets its own schema. Each returns structured output, never prose. In the Messages API the same guarantee is tool_choice {type: tool, name: report_findings}.

findings.detected_pattern: for i in range(1, len(items)): total += items[i].qty
findings.issue: total_qty starts the loop at index 1, so the first item's qty is never added. Its docstring says it sums the qty of every item in the list, so any non-empty list returns a total that is too low by items[0].qty. Single-item lists return 0.
findings.suggested_fix: Iterate over every item: `for i in items: total += i.qty` (or `return sum(i.qty for i in items)`). If the skip is intentional, the docstring and callers must change instead, and the '# PR 418 change' note should say why.

Given the empty_stock fixture (an empty list), total_qty returns 0. Passes against the current code; the empty_stock fixture exists in conftest.py but no test uses it yet.
